newsitem.title: USA: Gore calls Jacques Cousteau a hero.
newsitem.headline: Gore calls Jacques Cousteau a hero.

text.p: Vice President Al Gore on Wednesday called Jacques-Yves Cousteau a hero and said he learned a "tremendous amount" from the French sea explorer.
"He was a giant in every respect," Gore, in an interview with the Cable News Network, said of Cousteau, who died early Wednesday, aged 87.

"We had an opporunity to work together and I always learned a tremendous amount from him. He was a hero to men, women and children all over the world and we will miss him greatly. Our sympathies go to his family," Gore said.
The cause of death was not reported.
